protocol.phase_refinement: bounded scalar within one grid spacing
protocol.policy: One FIR and gain trained on MIDI91 +100ms. Later passages fit phase and remove DC only. No per-pitch gain, FIR, frequency or time-warp fit.
protocol.limitation: FIR has signed taps and noncausal offsets for identification, not a shipping implementation. Phase origin/delay and FIR coefficients are not uniquely identifiable. Candidate grid follows prior exploratory inspection; no blind validation or hardware-equivalence claim.
